correctness.rationale: For every p,q >=2, complete face classification identifies J_U*J_V and its two hub cones plus exactly E maximal edges. Both cone inclusions are nullhomotopic already in the full join; CW cofibers split as a join plus two suspensions. Discrete-set join homotopy yields ranks alpha, beta, alpha*beta integrally, while E edge attachments add E circles. Exact independent BFS face and mod-two Betti comparisons passed for 147 graphs with 28556 faces; the general proof supplies integral homotopy beyond finite computation.

value.rationale: Determines actual integral homotopy and all integral Betti ranks for an infinite natural family with two adjacent branching vertices and arbitrary independent arm subdivisions. It reveals simultaneous circles and distinct higher-dimensional sphere families, including the multiplicative cross-hub alpha*beta term. Unlike known general-position polynomials, this is a complete structural topological classification.
